messages:
Aisha: FYI I updated the starter sample in /samples/js to use dynamic import for the SDK to be edge-friendly, but we still need to ensure package.json exposes require() for node folks.
Ben: Nice. Example change looked like: const { InferenceClient } = await import('@redwood/inference'); - works great on Workers.
Clara: When we ran the tests some transitive deps tried to import package.json which failed because exports didn't allow ./package.json. Added ./package.json export in the patch.
Docs-bot: Added note to SDK migration guide: 'v0.12.0 narrowed exports to ESM-only; if you rely on require() upgrade to v0.12.1 which restores CJS entry or change your bundler config.'
QA-bot: Running matrix: node14-require, node16-esm, cloudflare-worker. All passing on patch candidate.
Aisha: Great, landing patch once reviews are in. Also checklist item: any future change to exports must run the INF-CI-exports-compat job.
Ben: Also rework the types entry to ensure consuming TS projects can `import type` from root without deep imports.
Clara: Will add a small unit test that imports types via ts-node.
Aisha: Ping me when released and I'll update sample docs and onboarding workshop slides.
